name: Match the Vehicle
tagline: Match vehicle types (electric, large, standard) to compatible parking spaces.
brief: Route electric cars to charging bays and large vehicles to large bays.
context: The lot has standard spaces, charging bays for electric cars, and wide bays for large vehicles.
narrative:
Vehicles with specific requirements are entering your lot.

Electric vehicles need charging bays, while large trucks need wide spaces. Assigning an electric car to a standard space or a large truck to a small spot causes a category violation!

Order your rules from specific vehicle requirements (carElectric, carLarge) down to the general standard vehicle fallback.
objective: Serve all eight vehicles without assigning a vehicle to an incompatible category.
learningObjective: Match specific resource requirements before applying general fallbacks.
intelligenceExplanation:
The starter controller routes everything to standard parking. Place specific rules above that fallback:
1. WHEN hasExitRequest -> DO release-vehicle
2. WHEN carElectric -> DO park-charging
3. WHEN carLarge -> DO park-large
4. WHEN hasWaitingVehicle -> DO park-standard
hint: Order rules: release-vehicle -> carElectric -> carLarge -> park-standard.
hints: Place specific carElectric and carLarge rules above the broad hasWaitingVehicle rule.
